answer: Like a tide that only lets strong swimmers ashore, an agent economy can price fake identities out with a hardware-linked progressive bond. First, each agent registers one hardware fingerprint and locks 2,000 POA for 60 days. Second, each extra identity from the same fingerprint costs 3x more: 2,000, 6,000, then 18,000 POA. Third, behavior audits flag clones and slash the whole bond. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn $480,000 in bonds and need 10,000 machines plus 30 days of checks. Honest agents sip the nectar of open trade while sybil farmers drown in sable water. - Jowy
